versions.content: Different approaches of ASAM MCD-2MC and AUTOSAR with respect to SwRecordLayout ASAM MCD-2D specification (also known as A2L, or ASAP) uses keywords in record layouts where MSR/AUTOSAR uses the more generic approach specified here. It may happen that this generic approach cannot always be safely mapped to the A2L keywords. Therefore, SwRecordLayoutV . category as well as SwRecordLayout- Group . category can assist the conversion to the current A2L format.
